title: routing_payload
description: M29 AC15 — skill-routing payload format consumed by vLLM (and stable across Claude/vLLM dispatchers). Pre-baked on the Claude side per Q7 LOCKED; full vLLM-side routing deferred to v1.9.0 (TD-M29-05). snake_case throughout; mirrors the style of the 11 existing v1 event schemas (draft-07, snake_case keys, additionalProperties: false).

active_skill_name.description: Slug of the skill the dispatcher selected (e.g., 'plan-reviewer'). Maps to skills/<active_skill_name>/SKILL.md on disk.

skill_body_excerpt.description: Excerpt of the selected skill's SKILL.md body, trimmed to fit the vLLM context budget. Empty string when the dispatcher could not resolve a skill.

expected_output_shape.description: Declared shape of the response the active skill expects from vLLM. Drives the AC18 quality-gate validator (validate_vllm_output).

fallback_to_claude_if.description: List of preconditions that, if present, instruct the vLLM caller to defer back to Claude instead of acting on the payload. Canonical markers: 'no_matching_skill', 'skill_body_too_large', 'output_shape_unknown'. Empty array means proceed.
